title: Recipments
body:
# **Recipments**
This Mod for Neoforge 1.21.1 adds many more **Advancements** and **Recipes** to the Game.
This Mod isn't Meant to be OP or Add too much _"Fast Progression"_ it is meant to be a Mod for Getting Stuff more easily and More Advancements for Difficulty and because I Think there should be more Advancements.

### **Recipes Added:**
- Fast Stick
  - Crafting Table
  - Two logs on Top of Eachother (Stick Recipe but with Logs)
  - Outputs 16 Sticks
- Chest Barrel
  - Crafting Table
  - A Chest in the Middle Row and A Wood Slab on top and bottom of the Chest
  - Outputs a Barrel
- Barrel Chest
  - Crafting Table
  - A Single Barrel
  - Outputs a Chest
- Wood to Sticks
  - Stone Cutting
  - Any Wooden Planks
  - Outputs 4 Sticks
- Chainmail Armour
  - Crafting Table
  - Regular Armou Recipes but With Iron Nuggets
  - Outputs Chainmail Armour (Depending on Armour)
- NameTag
  - Crafting Table
  - Iron in Top Right and Paper in the Middle Row
  - Outputs a NameTag
- Renewable Sand
  - Stone Cutter
  - Any Stone
  - Outputs a Sand Block
- Notch Apple
  - Crafting Table
  - A Golden Apple in the Middle surrounded by Golden Blocks
  - Outputs a Enchanted Golden Apple
- Grass Block 1/2/3
  - Crafting Table
  - Dirt on Bottom and Grass/Tall Grass/Wheat Seeds on Top
  - Outputs a Grass Block
- Webs
  - Crafting Table
  - 5 String in a X Shape
  - Outputs 4 Cobwebs
- Calcite
  - Crafting Table
  - In a 4 by 4 Crafting grid Quartz in Top left / Bottom Right and Diorite in Top Right / Bottom Left
  - Outputs 2 Calcite
- Tuff
  - Crafting Table
  - In a 4 by 4 Crafting grid Quartz in Top left / Bottom Right and Cobblestone in Top Right / Bottom Left
  - Outputs 2 Tuff
- Gilded Blackstone
  - Crafting Table
  - A Blackstone in the Middle surrounded by Gold Nuggets
  - Outputs a Gilded Blackstone
- Leather Horse Armour
  - Crafting Table
  - Leather in a Helmet Shape but with one extra in the Top Right
  - Outputs Leather Horse Armour
- Iron Horse Armour
  - Crafting Table
  - Iron Ingots in a Helemt Shape with one extra in the Top Right and a Iron Nugget in the Middle instead of a Iron Ingot
  - Outputs Iron Horse Armour
- Gold Horse Armour
  - Crafting Table
  - Gold Ingots in a Helemt Shape with one extra in the Top Right and a Gold Nugget in the Middle instead of a Gold Ingot
  - Outputs Gold Horse Armour
- Diamond Horse Armour
  - Crafting Table
  - Diamond in a Helemt Shape with one extra in the Top Right and a Saddle in the Middle instead of a Diamond
  - Outputs Diamond Horse Armour

### **Advancements Added:**
- Christmas Present
  - Get Coal
- Redlectricty
  - Get Redstone
- Diamonds??????
  - Get Lapis Lazuli
- Its All Yours
  - Get a Spyglass
- Circuits
  - Place Redstone Dust
- Dapper Suit
  - Get Full Iron Armour
- OO' Shiny
  - Get Full Diamond Armour
- Acquire Software
  - Get Raw Iron
- The Coppas
  - Get Copper Ingot
- Monster
  - Get Full Leather Armour
- Shiny Stone
  - Get Emerald
- Stonks
  - Have 5 Stacks of Emeralds
- The Rarest Block In Minecraft
  - Have Deepslate Emerald Ore and Deepslate Coal Ore
- Is This Tuff
  - Place Tuff
- Watch Your Step
  - Enter a Deep Dark
